name: Accordion

props.name: align
props.description: Specify the alignment of the accordion heading title and chevron. Defaults to `end`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether an individual AccordionItem should be disabled.

props.name: isFlush
props.description: Specify whether Accordion text should be flush, default is `false`, does not work with `align="start"`.

props.name: ordered
props.description: Specify if the Accordion should be an ordered list, default is `false`

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Accordion. Currently supports the following: `sm`, `md`, `lg`

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Accordion rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
